source_lineage.rp_altitude_origin: Case Study J — Governance ↔ System-Level Interaction Layer (v1.0)
source_lineage.conversion_readme: Case Study J Simulation Triad Experiment README (v1.0)

modulation.description: Models modulation between governance boundaries and system-level operational surfaces using bounded structural channels.

cross_surface_alignment.description: Routes and aligns structural flows between governance and system surfaces without expressive geometry.

gating.description: Applies system-level gating across governance-system interaction surfaces.

stabilization.description: Maintains stable interaction geometry during governance-to-system transitions and modulation cycles.

dissipation.description: Models dissipation of interaction intensity within bounded simulation envelopes.

residual_looping.description: Models residual looping behavior within interaction basins formed by governance-system modulation.

non_activation_clause.description: This behavioral model is structural-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, expressive geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, or manifold process.
